title: handwriter texo checkpoints
description: Private: Texo (alephpi/FormulaNet, AGPL-3.0) base weights + handwriter fine-tuned checkpoints on MathWriting (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0): v1 (5k subset), v2 best (epoch 2, human train), v3 best (epoch 4, human + synthetic inks with stroke augmentation; deepcopy test beam4 lp0 62.55% exact), v4 best (colour-InkML specialist, test beam4 lp0 63.98% exact; not for photos), and v5 best (shipped default; mixed colour/grey/photo, 4 epochs; colour 63.91%, grey InkML 63.80%, deepcopy 63.72% exact). Plus handwriter code.
